title: orion check: speak only when something changed (update offer, rules fingerprint, per-repository record, personal rules offer)
summary: Resumed the story an earlier run released after three review rounds: the last finding (a broken-pipe line on stderr when the cache folder cannot be written and SIGPIPE is ignored) is fixed with a test that fails without it, a fresh review approved, and the pull request merged. The session-start check now speaks only when something changed; orion goes from version 17 to 18.

deferred.what: The PRD still says a missing status line or personal rules copy is named as what it is, and that the personal rules offer comes once a day per computer; the shipped check stays silent on a missing copy and offers once per clause version, so a later story or a reconcile pass could read the new behaviour as a bug
deferred.why: A PRD is edited by its owner, never by an agent in a dev run
